module: Flowgraph node "Set Recovery Prompt Active" (category once_instant). Enables or disables the mission recovery system (core_recoveryPrompt). To be used with "Set Recovery Prompt Enabled" to make the buttons selectable. Input pins: active (default true), enableAll (obsolete, hidden), flipMission, recoverMission (default true), submitMission, restartMission (default false). Depends on gameplay_walk and blocks the gameplay reset (blocksOnResetGameplay).

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the flowgraph editor (ImGui).

workOnce.desc: If active is true: calls core_recoveryPrompt.setActive(true), disables all buttons then enables those whose pin is not nil. Otherwise calls core_recoveryPrompt.setActive(false).
